title: Han Solo
description: HAN SOLO, an infamous spice smuggler, is also an ace starship pilot. With his faithful companion, Chewbacca, he seeks his fortune while eluding galactic bounty hunters and Imperial forces. A simple "taxi" job puts him in the middle of the titanic clash between good and evil. Ever the reluctant hero, he helps Princess Leia, saves Luke's life, and gets frozen in carbonite before being rescued by his new friends.
